These targets are further connected to Acyl-CoA hydrolase, indicating a possible pathway through which 1,3,5-Tri-tert-butylbenzene may influence Acyl-CoA hydrolase activity. The scores from the three paths are consistent, suggesting a plausible biological connection. However, the evidence is not definitive, and further experimental validation is needed to establish a causal relationship. The mechanisms involved appear to be related to the modulation of ion channels, which in turn may affect metabolic processes involving Acyl-CoA hydrolase.
